name: SLR-Bench-Spanish
description:
🧠 SLR-Bench-Spanish: Scalable Logical Reasoning Benchmark (Spanish Edition)
	





	
		
	
	
		SLR-Bench Versions:
	




SLR-Bench-Spanish is the Spanish-language pendant of the original SLR-Bench dataset.
It follows the same symbolic structure, evaluation framework, and curriculum as the English version but provides all natural-language task prompts translated into Spanish.
This enables systematic evaluation and training of Large Language Models (LLMs) in logical reasoning in… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/ahmad21omar/SLR-Bench-Spanish.
reputation: Spanish translation of an established logical-reasoning benchmark; modest community usage for Spanish LLM evaluation.
